wip_constraint: WIP-1 per subagent; qa exits after inject + handoff write + completion signal; dev-ta spawned only AFTER qa completion signal lands
trial_context: Second G11 trial. E2 yielded outcome-(a) per E1 spec §4 step 5 (fix did not break canary B). E1 spec §7 recommends alternate canary pair if outcome (a) repeats — MACD goldens (macd-golden.json, macd-bullish-cross.json) which share the calcEMA helper directly with the macd/ema.go TODO refactor temptation.

step1_qa_inject_instructions.task: Inject a fresh bug into a MACD/EMA shared helper (per E-series spec §7 alternate canary pairs). The bug MUST cause the MACD primary scenario to flip RED AND cause at least one additional canary scenario (a different primitive sharing the EMA helper or a sibling MACD scenario) to also flip RED. This double-RED coupling is the explicit G11 trip-wire.
step1_qa_inject_instructions.target_helper: apps/technical-analysis/pkg/primitive/macd/ema.go OR apps/technical-analysis/pkg/primitive/macd/macd.go — whichever has the calcEMA seed/recursive smoothing logic. DO NOT touch rsi.go (we already exhausted that bug class in D2/E2). Single-token or 2-token mutation only.
step1_qa_inject_instructions.expected_canary_red: macd-bullish-cross.json (sibling scenario sharing same calcEMA path) OR ma-sma-vs-ema.json (if EMA helper is shared across packages — verify before inject)
must_stay_green_canaries: rsi-golden.json (independent primitive — verifies you only broke MACD/EMA path)
step1_qa_inject_instructions.verification_before_commit: Run sandbox iteratively over every primitive + module scenario; confirm primary RED + at least one canary RED + all independent-primitive goldens GREEN. If only primary is RED (no canary coupling), pick a different mutation point or a different helper line — the whole purpose is to test the alarm bell.
step1_qa_inject_instructions.commit_format: test(technical-analysis): P2-E3-inject — MACD/EMA <one-liner about the math distortion, NO mention of dev-ta strategy>
step1_qa_inject_instructions.staging_rule: L84 — explicit file paths only. Stage only: apps/technical-analysis/pkg/primitive/macd/<helper>.go + docs/handoffs/TASK_P2-E3.md + docs/signals/qa-P2-E3-inject-<UTC>.json. No broad globs.
step1_qa_inject_instructions.handoff_overwrite: Overwrite docs/handoffs/TASK_P2-E3.md per ownership-transfer protocol (cycle-14 E2 precedent). Frontmatter: status: pending, owner: dev-technical-analysis, gate: P2-E3, anchor: 62edbf3d. Body MUST include: §Forbidden Inputs (8-path list — see template below), §Dashboard Signal (verbatim list of RED scenarios with no source-line hints), §Allowed Inputs (sandbox runner + Go source + scenario fixtures + Wikipedia + own handoff/dispatch), §Sandbox Command (explicit per-file iteration loop — NOT -scenario=all per POLICY DEBT-1 Option B), §Acceptance Criteria (primary RED→GREEN, ALL 30 scenarios GREEN, ≤2 cycle budget, forbidden-reads compliance self-reported, G12 DoD honored). The dev-ta side MUST NOT see: spec links, qa inject commit SHA, source paths beyond the generic Go source directory, bug-type hints (no 'EMA', no 'MACD', no 'calcEMA', no 'smoothing'), prior commit SHAs.
step1_qa_inject_instructions.completion_signal: docs/signals/qa-P2-E3-inject-<UTC>.json with: {status:done, commit:<SHA>, red_scenarios:[<filenames>], green_canaries_held:[<filenames>], helper_modified:<path>, mutation_summary:<one_line>, ac_pass:[AC-1..AC-5], handoff_ownership_transferred:true}
forbidden_inputs_template_for_dev_ta_han: docs/handoffs/TASK_P2-E1.md / TASK_P2-E2.md (only the current TASK_P2-E3.md may be read)
Any docs/signals/qa-* or docs/signals/dev-ta-* file from earlier in the pilot
git log filtered to prior commits on any primitive source file
step1_qa_inject_instructions.stall_watch_self_report: if you cannot complete step 1 within 25 minutes, write a BLOCKED completion signal and exit — PO will re-route

step2_dev_ta_dispatch_instructions_FOR_P.trigger: qa step1 completion signal landed (docs/signals/qa-P2-E3-inject-<UTC>.json with status:done)
step2_dev_ta_dispatch_instructions_FOR_P.no_cheat_payload: PO will spawn dev-technical-analysis with prompt containing ONLY: (a) dashboard RED summary verbatim from qa's red_scenarios field, (b) sandbox command from handoff §Sandbox Command, (c) path to docs/handoffs/TASK_P2-E3.md. PO will NEVER mention: calcEMA, MACD, EMA, Wilder, smoothing, qa inject commit SHA, ema.go, macd.go, prior commit SHAs.
step2_dev_ta_dispatch_instructions_FOR_P.background_spawn: claude -p with R-11 background pattern (cycle-7 + cycle-13 precedent — successful in <5 min wallclock when scope is clean)

no_cheat_clause_binding: rule 6 of Cycle-Counting Protocol — handoff + dispatch signal contain ONLY dashboard RED summary + sandbox command + Forbidden Inputs list. No source paths beyond the package directory, no spec links, no bug-type hints, no prior commit SHAs
constraints_for_qa_subagent: WIP-1 (do NOT pick up dev-ta dispatch — PO handles that)
no mutation of docs/data/pilot-status.json (PO authorship rule §4.5)

expected_g11_outcomes.outcome_a: dev-ta fix repairs primary AND the coupled canary in same fix — alarm fire N/A, regression detected but resolved in 1 cycle (excellent — G11 PASS)
expected_g11_outcomes.outcome_b: dev-ta fix repairs primary, canary stays RED, dev-ta detects via sandbox + fixes canary in same task before declaring done — G11 PASS BY ALARM (the gold-standard signal we want)
expected_g11_outcomes.outcome_c: dev-ta fix repairs primary, declares done while canary still RED — G12 DoD gate FAILS, G11 PARTIAL (alarm did not fire in agent loop)
